bonus.text: In 2023 Mexico City declared its sonidero culture intangible heritage. Months earlier, 30+ sonideros had spun cumbia and salsa for 12 hours to over 100,000 dancers in the Zócalo.
At Oaxaca’s Guelaguetza, dancers from the state’s eight regions perform on two July Mondays, the Lunes del Cerro. After each dance, communities offer crafts and fruit to the audience.
Michoacán’s Danza de los Viejitos has Purépecha roots. Dancers in pink-cheeked old-man masks shuffle stooped and slow, then burst into strong stomping.
